verses.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: And Job again took up his parable, and said:

verses.he: חַי־אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right; And the Almighty, who hath dealt bitterly with me;

verses.he: כִּֽי־כָל־ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.en: All the while my breath is in me And the spirit of God is in my nostrils,

verses.he: אִם־תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם־יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit;

verses.he: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם־אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד־אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא־אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Far be it from me that I should justify you; Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.

verses.he: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא־יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי׃
verses.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go; My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

verses.he: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃
verses.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.

verses.he: כִּ֤י מַה־תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?

verses.he: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ אֵ֑ל כִּֽי־תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃
verses.en: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?

verses.he: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל־עֵֽת׃
verses.en: Will he have his delight in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?

verses.he: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃
verses.en: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

verses.he: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?

verses.he: זֶ֤ה׀ חֵֽלֶק־אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע׀ עִם־אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

verses.he: אִם־יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ־חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not have bread enough.

verses.he: שרידו [שְׂ֭רִידָיו] בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried by pestilence, And his widows shall make no lamentation.

verses.he: אִם־יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;

verses.he: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃
verses.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.

verses.he: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃
verses.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.

verses.he: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: He lieth down rich, but there shall be nought to gather; He openeth his eyes, and his wealth is not.

verses.he: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.en: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.

verses.he: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.

verses.he: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃
verses.en: Yea, it hurleth at him, and spareth not; He would fain flee from its power.

verses.he: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
